routes.title: 01 • Culture return → inlet pump
routes.detail: Used culture water enters the rear inlet-duty pump. Collector geometry is illustrative.
label: RETURN

routes.title: Culture B → return collector
routes.detail: Second bank joins the culture return.

routes.title: 02 • Inlet pump → sand filter
routes.detail: Inlet pump feeds multiport PUMP connection.

routes.title: 03 • Sand filter → skimmer
routes.detail: Normal FILTER mode passes through the sand bed and returns to the skimmer.

routes.title: 04 • Skimmer → BIO-1
routes.detail: Skimmer treated-water outlet continues into the first biological chamber.

routes.title: 05 • BIO-1 → BIO-2
routes.detail: Biological treatment sequence; partition apertures and levels are not dimensioned.

routes.title: 06 • BIO-2 → UV chamber
routes.detail: Aerated biological chamber passes water to the chamber containing three UV assemblies.

routes.title: 07 • UV → outlet pump
routes.detail: Final treated water reaches front outlet-duty pump.

routes.title: 08 • Outlet pump → high supply header
routes.detail: Pressurized culture supply header from front STP50. External pipe sizing is unresolved.
label: CULTURE SUPPLY

routes.title: 09 • Supply → culture A
routes.detail: Representative distribution through the bank; detailed branch plumbing and box flow are not asserted.

routes.title: 09 • Supply → culture B
routes.detail: Representative high supply and low return serving the second bank.

routes.title: Culture bottom-discharge interface
routes.detail: Manual describes pond bottom draining one unit at a time. Rack adaptation and outfall are unresolved.
label: CULTURE PURGE / H08

routes.title: Multiport WASTE interface
routes.detail: BACKWASH, RINSE or WASTE outlet; preview does not set the valve or prescribe a two-pump sequence.
label: FILTER WASTE / H08

routes.title: Foam-cup discharge interface
routes.detail: Functional cup discharge only. Not identified with either ambiguous manual skimmer waste stub.
label: CUP / H08

routes.title: Biological cleaning → common waste interface
routes.detail: Illustrative manifold association; individual chamber-to-valve connections are unverified. Skid common waste connection is diameter 50 mm.
label: SKID WASTE / H08

routes.title: Separate high-level overflow interface
routes.detail: Separate overflow function. Pipe diameter, capacity and final destination are unknown.
label: OVERFLOW / H08

routes.title: Sand-removal service interface
routes.detail: Spent sand and wash water during media replacement. No receiving container is established.
label: SAND / H08

routes.title: Unidentified skimmer waste stubs
routes.detail: Manual shows two Waste outlet stubs, but their cup/body functions are unresolved. One boundary marker represents the unresolved pair, not a merged pipe.
label: STUB ID / H08

routes.title: Supply → panel
routes.detail: Manufacturer assembly supply: 220 V AC, 50 Hz, 1.8 kW input. Protection and PE path are not defined here.
label: 220 V AC · 50 Hz

routes.title: Panel → outlet pump
routes.detail: STP50 front pump: 0.37 kW input, 2.0 A. Supplier Pump1 match reconstructed.

routes.title: Panel → inlet pump
routes.detail: Rear pump present; model, watts and current unresolved.

routes.title: Panel → UV assemblies
routes.detail: Three lamps visible; ballast allocation and input watts unresolved.

routes.title: Panel → external LP-100
routes.detail: Functional supply association only; control-branch identity and electrical ratings unresolved.

routes.title: Panel → ozone unit
routes.detail: Ozone unit has its own timer and two local controls; no common aerator circuit inferred.

routes.title: LP-100 → BIO-2 aeration
routes.detail: External air pump supplies the second biological chamber. Green rising bubbles depict aeration, with no assumed diffuser design.
label: AERATION

routes.title: Ozone unit → skimmer intake
routes.detail: Separate ozone service to skimmer gas intake; local internal air pump differs from LP-100.
label: OZONE GAS

routes.title: Skimmer off-gas boundary
routes.detail: Undocumented exhaust/residual-treatment boundary. Dashed indicator is not a traced hose, installed vent or confirmed destructor.
label: OFF-GAS / H05

routes.title: Optional makeup → culture units
routes.detail: Preconditioned makeup water is introduced through culture units in the manual. This dashed service boundary is not a supplied tank, pump, automatic valve or traced tie-in.
label: MAKEUP / H07

routes.title: Culture B bottom-discharge interface
routes.detail: Second bank purge shown as a separate conceptual boundary. External collection and rack adaptation are unresolved; this is not a simultaneous draining instruction.
label: BANK B PURGE / H08

water: Crab boxes → inlet pump → sand filter → skimmer → BIO-1 → BIO-2 → UV → outlet pump → boxes.
Blue arrows follow the manufacturer’s process order. Physical routes and box distribution are schematic. 6–10 m³/h is package throughput, not stored water volume.
waste: Orange: bottom purge, multiport waste, cup discharge, biological cleaning and sand removal. Rose: separate high-level overflow.
Service previews are shown together for explanation; they are not simultaneous normal operation. Each path stops at its own open interface. External destinations and valve mapping remain H08.
electrical: 220 V AC / 50 Hz supply → panel → two pumps, UV assemblies, LP-100 and ozone unit.
Dashed amber links identify functional loads, not verified wiring or AC current direction. Package input: 1.8 kW. Terminal assignments, protection, earth path and branch mapping remain H06/H09.
air: Green: external LP-100 aeration → BIO-2. Violet: ozone unit → skimmer gas intake.
The ozone unit’s local AIR PUMP control is distinct from the external LP-100. Diffuser geometry and hose paths are schematic. Off-gas and residual-oxidant treatment remain H05.
all: Blue water · orange waste · amber power · green air · violet ozone.
Choose a system to isolate it. Animated markers explain direction or functional delivery; their speed is illustrative. Geometry is a schematic reconstruction, not an installation drawing.

RACK_A: Individual crab boxes receive water from a high header and discharge to a lower collector. Two banks are illustrated; rendered boxes are representative, not an installed count.
C: E2; M11. Geometry/quantity: OPEN H07.
RACK_B: Second representative bank. Box dimensions, operating volumes and branch flows are not established.
P102: Rear pump with basket strainer, reconstructed as inlet duty: culture return to sand filter. Complete plate is unreadable; no front-pump ratings are copied.
F101: Pressure sand filter with multiport. Manufacturer sand charge: 22 kg. Normal FILTER service leads to the skimmer. Waste outlet identification is reconstructed.
C: M4,6–7; E4–5. R: port identification. OPEN H10.
SK101: Mixing/reaction column with foam collection cup. Water continues to BIO-1; collected foam is a separate waste service. Two other manual waste stubs remain unidentified.
BIO1: First biological chamber in manufacturer sequence. Internal media, fill and operating level are unspecified. Rendered internals are schematic.
BIO2: Second biological chamber receives external air-pump service. Bubbles illustrate aeration; diffuser hardware and airflow remain unknown.
UV: Three lamp assemblies in final treatment chamber. Source does not establish three serial hydraulic reactors. Lamp life: 8,000 h; watts, drivers and dose unverified.
P101: Front STP50 returns treated water to culture supply. Plate: 0.37 kW input, 0.25 kW output, 2.0 A; rated 6 m³/h at 7 m. Pump duty is reconstructed.
A101: External aerator serving BIO-2. LP-100 is the model name, not an established wattage or airflow. Separate from ozone unit local AIR PUMP control.
OZ101: Ozone generator with local timer and OZONE / AIR PUMP controls. Gas service to skimmer is documented; installed hose trace, dose and off-gas handling are not.
CP101: Six indicator lenses, five selector knobs and one UV controller window. Seven printed circuit branches cannot be uniquely mapped to installed loads.
